comment: Personally, I would appreciate AI assistance in learning, becoming familiar with, and using Buckets. The old concept of paper envelopes containing only the month's available money has been modernized, digitized, and, above all, made fun. An excellent idea! And rather well executed, from what I've seen so far in my learning. But I do feel quite alone when I get stuck on a specific point, so much so that I've already successfully used AI to find answers to questions that seemed unsolvable. In almost two months, thanks to AI, I've made considerable progress, starting from scratch. I remain convinced that Buckets should remain a practical and accessible tool for everyone, with the ultimate goal of preventing us from falling into debt, a fate unfortunately reserved for many of us in these difficult times, all over the world..
name: Leborne
